snippet.title: Dave the Diver - Launch Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
DAVE THE DIVER is a casual, single player adventure RPG featuring deep-sea exploration. 

Fishing during the day and managing a sushi restaurant at night, join Dave and his quirky friends as they seek to uncover the secrets of the mysterious Blue Hole!

The ocean awaits! Available today with Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC and Xbox Cloud as an Xbox Play Anywhere title!
